profile_text: As an online retailer of nutritional supplements and health products, this company has experienced significant growth, with a 74.3% increase in employees since its baseline. Specializing in e-commerce sales of health-related products, its online platform has enabled the business to expand its customer reach and drive sales. With 61 employees as of 2024, its scalable model has earned it a "Scaler" category designation, indicating its potential for continued expansion.
